import.title: Import from Telegram
import.instruction: Export your data in Telegram Desktop: “Export Telegram data” or “Export chat history”, in JSON format. You do not need to export files, photos or voice messages: they are not imported yet, and a note stays in the entry in their place.
import.twoDevices: If you import the same file on two devices before they sync, entries will be duplicated.
import.nothing: The file has no chats that can be imported.

report.title: Import finished
report.stoppedNote: What was written stays in the journal. Choose the same file again to import the rest.
report.media: Entries with attachments not imported: {{count, number}}

search.label: Search results
search.hint: Type a word or the start of one.

feed.label: Entries
feed.empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first note below.

message.moveMenu: Move to chat: choose a chat

confirm.title: Delete forever?
confirm.text: The entry cannot be brought back.

recovery.title: The database is damaged
recovery.startupText: The damaged file is not deleted: Kinige moves it aside next to the database. Entries made after the last backup may not have been saved.
recovery.runningText: A check found damage in the database. Kinige will restart and offer backups to restore it from.
recovery.noneHint: The backup folder is empty. Save the database file and write to the developer: entries may still be recoverable from it.
recovery.mirrorNote: The Markdown copy folder will be renamed to “…-before-restore-…” next to it: entries made after the backup snapshot are not lost.
recovery.tooNewTitle: The database was created by a newer version of Kinige
recovery.tooNewText: Downgrading is not supported: update the app. Nothing has been changed or deleted.

error.store_write_failed: Could not save the entry. The text is still in the field.
error.shortcut_invalid: This shortcut cannot be used. Try another one.
error.shortcut_taken: This shortcut is already used by another app or the system.
error.shortcut_duplicate: The other action already uses this shortcut.
error.message_not_found: The entry was not found. It may have been deleted for good.
error.message_in_trash: The entry is in the trash: restore it first, then move it.
error.read_only: This entry was written by a newer version of Kinige and is read-only. Update the app.
error.inbox_protected: Inbox cannot be renamed, archived or deleted.
error.not_in_trash: Only an entry from the trash can be deleted for good.
error.chat_title_too_long: A chat name is at most 128 characters.
error.chat_icon_invalid: That emoji did not work. Pick another one.
error.task_item_stale: The entry text has changed. The item was not toggled.
error.database_too_new: The database was created by a newer version of Kinige. Update the app.
error.backup_not_found: The copy was not found or cannot be opened.
error.mirror_folder_busy: Could not rename the Markdown copy folder (it may be open in another program). Nothing was changed: close it and try again.
error.import_not_telegram: This is not a Telegram export. You need the result.json file from Telegram Desktop in JSON format. Nothing was written.
error.import_file_unreadable: The file could not be read. Nothing was written.
error.import_file_too_large: The file is larger than 1 GB. Export without media or only the chat you need.
error.import_session_expired: The chosen file was forgotten. Choose it again.
error.import_backup_failed: Could not take a copy of the database before the import. Nothing was written.

enable.label: Allow agents to access the journal
enable.description: An agent you connect can read the chats you mark below and, if you allow it, write entries.
enable.warning: The text an agent reads goes to the provider of its model. Kinige's end-to-end encryption does not cover it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.hint: After changing the mode, reconnect the agent.

chats.title: Chats visible to the agent
chats.description: Nothing is marked at first: until you mark chats, the agent sees an empty journal.

connect.title: How to connect
connect.desktopTitle: Claude Desktop: add this to claude_desktop_config.json and restart the app
connect.desktopHint: If the config already has mcpServers, add kinige inside it.
connect.codeTitle: Claude Code: run this in a terminal

error.dir_unsafe: The folder for the agent socket belongs to someone else or is a link, so agent access is unavailable.
error.second_instance: Another Kinige is already running on this data, so agent access is unavailable here.
error.bind_failed: Kinige could not open the agent socket, so agent access is unavailable.
error.bridge_missing: The connector file is not next to the app (a development build), so there is nothing to connect.

appearance.description: How large the text is throughout Kinige.

access.logValue: What agents asked for and wrote

file.description: All settings live in one plain text file. You, or an AI agent, can edit it: Kinige notices the change within a couple of seconds.
file.unknownKey: {{key}}: Kinige does not know this key, ignores it and keeps it in the file

problem.parse: The file could not be read: line {{line}}, column {{column}}. Nothing was changed.
problem.not_object: The file must be a JSON object. Nothing was changed.
problem.not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 text. Nothing was changed.
problem.bom: The file starts with a byte order mark: save it as UTF-8 without BOM. Nothing was changed.
problem.too_large: The file is larger than 1 MiB. Nothing was changed.
problem.io: Kinige could not read or write the file.

unsafe.symlink: The file is a symbolic link, so access and folder keys from it are ignored.
unsafe.not_regular: This is not a regular file, so it is not read.
unsafe.owner: The file belongs to another user, so access and folder keys from it are ignored.
unsafe.permissions: Other users can write to the file, so access and folder keys from it are ignored. Make it writable only by you (chmod 600), then save the file again.
unsafe.directory: Other users can write to the data folder, so access and folder keys from the file are ignored.

issue.shortcut_duplicate: {{key}}: the other action already uses this shortcut
issue.shortcut_taken: {{key}}: the shortcut is used by another app or the system
issue.folder_not_absolute: {{key}}: the folder path must be absolute
issue.folder_inside_data: {{key}}: the folder must not be inside Kinige's data folder
issue.unsafe_ignored: {{key}}: ignored because the file is not safe
issue.chat_ambiguous: {{key}}: several chats have this name, use the id
issue.chat_excluded: {{key}}: this chat is excluded from AI

mirror.title: Markdown copy
mirror.description: Every entry is also written to a plain Markdown file, one file per day, so you can read your journal without Kinige.
mirror.warning: The copy is plain text: anyone who can open the folder can read your entries.
mirror.upToDate: The copy is up to date
mirror.pending_one: {{count}} day is waiting to be written
mirror.pending_other: {{count}} days are waiting to be written

error.folder_unavailable: The folder is not available. Entries are kept and will be written when it works again.
error.write_failed: Could not write the copy. Entries are kept; Kinige will try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Work in any app, even when Kinige is in the background.
shortcuts.recording: Press the new shortcut with ⌃, ⌥ or ⌘… Esc to cancel
shortcuts.taken: Not assigned: already used by another app or the system

backup.title: Database backup
backup.description: The 7 latest daily backups are kept, plus one taken before each update.

error.folder_unavailable: The backup folder is unavailable. Daily backups are not taken until it works again.
error.write_failed: Could not write the backup. Kinige will try again.
error.integrity_failed: A check found damage in the database. The daily backup is not taken, so a damaged copy cannot push out the good ones.
error.purge_failed: Automatic trash cleanup could not remove a damaged entry; it stays in the trash. Backups and checks keep working.
